title: Plux localisation report
description: The compiler's localisation report of a release: per locale and plugin, how many translation keys are covered, approved, missing or left out (I18N-008, ADR-0068).

defaultLocale.description: The app's default locale, whose texts always ship.

requireApproved.description: True when the app requires approved translations.

locales.description: One entry per locale and plugin, sorted by locale with pseudo-locales last, then by plugin.

plugin.description: The plugin's key; empty for all the keys of the app.

translated.description: Keys that have a message in the locale, shipped or not.

approved.description: Translated keys whose state is approved.

missing.description: Keys with no message in the locale.

leftOutUnapproved.description: Messages the release leaves out because they are not approved (PLX-1610).

missingKeys.description: Names of the missing keys, sorted; listed on the entry of the whole app only.

leftOutKeys.description: Names of the keys left out, sorted; listed on the entry of the whole app only.

unusedKeys.description: Names of the keys the default locale translates and nothing references (PLX-1608), sorted.
